Functional Analyst M/V/X
Référence 5889716
|
Créé le 03 juillet 2026
Retour à la liste
Temps de travail :
Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Durée indéterminée
Famille de métiers :
Informatique / Logiciel - Software
Nombre d'années d'expérience :
Minimum 4 ans d'expérience
Description de la fonction
Our partner, a
key player in the enterprise payments domain
, is looking for a Senior Functional Analyst to reinforce their team.
You'll be part of a mature agile team working on
next-generation digital and transactional solutions
. The ideal candidate can not only translate business needs into clear functional requirements, but also
collaborate closely with the IT team
to guide implementation and ensure functional coherence.
Role
Playing a key role in
functional analysis
, identifying, detailing, and documenting business needs
Supporting your
IT colleagues
by handing over well-defined functional designs and being available throughout the implementation process
Working in a technically rich environment based on
Java and AWS
, with a strong focus on
microservices
,
API integration
, and
data modelling
Using tools like
JIRA
and
Confluence
to manage requirements and documentation within an agile delivery model
Collaborating with developers, testers, and architects to ensure
future-proof and scalable solutions
This is a
long-term assignment
with a
hybrid work model
. The client offers a stable, structured environment with room for proactive input and ownership.
Profil
Profile
At least
5 years of relevant experience
as a Functional Analyst
A
solid IT background
- you understand how systems are built and work
Experience in
Java/AWS-based environments
Hands-on knowledge of
API testing
(Postman), microservice design, and basic
data modelling
Excellent communication skills and the ability to align business and technical stakeholders
Compétences linguistiques
Néérlandais (atout)
Comprendre : Elémentaire (A)
Écrire : Elémentaire (A)
Lire : Elémentaire (A)
Parler : Elémentaire (A)
Avantages du poste
Offer
immediatly start
longterm contract with extensions
Benefits
Parking
3 days remote
